text: Every exposed shell, SDK, browser, MCP/connector and direct-egress path must enforce the same actual resource policy boundary, including child processes bypassing cooperative brokers.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§2 AF-13,10 Tools as effect contracts,13; docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv:14; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security + integration: enumerate each exposed path, execute an allowed owned-fixture operation and equivalent forbidden file/process/network attempts through each, including direct children; observe destination and filesystem/process effects. Repeat on approved Linux deployment before claiming containment.

text: Effective execution authority must be the intersection of organization, Space, role, task intent/envelope, tool rules and qualified runtime capabilities.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §14 A policy hierarchy; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: unit + security integration: independently restrict each dimension and assert denied dispatch/effects despite permission in all others; retain a fully authorized successful case.

text: Client manifests, current-Space/tenant/owner/payer/role values, prompts, model outputs and MCP descriptions must not create authority.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§3 Switching,7,14,26; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security integration: forged/stale fields, hostile repo/tool/web content and misleading MCP metadata cannot retarget or elevate actual execution; inspect immutable records and effects.

text: An operation must be governed by its actual resource and effect rather than its tool name; unknown high-impact effects must be blocked or require human execution.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §10 A task envelope; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security integration: disguise equivalent external/protected writes as shell, browser, SDK and MCP operations; unknown effects cause zero dispatch/mutation and expose a safe refusal.

text: Missing, expired or lost mandatory runtime controls must block affected scheduling/continuation without silent fallback to local, unapproved-region or weaker execution.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§7 Three execution classes,12–13,25; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security + recovery integration: remove required capabilities before admission and mid-run, expire qualification and attempt alternative paths; verify actual refusal/cessation, zero fallback allocation and clear blocked state.

text: The qualified runtime must protect policy/control services from arbitrary task and third-party executable-plugin modification.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§7,13 Independent authority,25; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: security: under worker identity attempt modification of policy authority and control-service interfaces/files from opened paths; inspect protected state remains unchanged on actual deployment; local refusal evidence remains limited.

text: Workers must not modify protected checks, protected receipts or audit/security sinks; worker diagnostics must remain distinct from verifier evidence.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§10 Protected completion,13 Evidence,22; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Should”
verify: security + review: worker attempts check/receipt/audit tampering and self-reported pass injection are denied; verifier-owned receipt identity and unchanged protected data are independently observed.

text: Broad credentials, signing/gateway master keys and host-administration sockets must remain outside worker-readable prompts, files and mounts; supported credentials must be brokered and narrowly scoped.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§10 Protected completion,11,12 Deployment profiles,13 Secrets
verify: security: inspect launch mounts/environment and synthetic secret canaries; attempt file/socket/key access from each exposed worker path and verify no disclosure or host-control access.

text: Computer readiness must be withheld until image, policy, mounts, capacity/resource limits, workload identity and current access are validated.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §12 Persistent identity and Computer startup; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration + security: actual startup positive case and one invalid/missing input per prerequisite; inspect no terminal/dispatch/Ready before validation and explicit preparation/failure phases.

text: Advertised Linux resource limits must be proven by actual enforcement on the selected host/kernel/image rather than inferred from adapter declarations.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §12 Deployment profiles; docs/planning/g1-foundations-plan.md:18; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: security + integration on approved deployment: launch bounded owned workloads against advertised process/CPU/memory/resource controls and observe enforced behavior, image/kernel/architecture and required host capabilities; retain unavailable cases as unqualified.

text: A startup-only filesystem/process policy change must remain Pending recreation until a worker reports the matching qualified runtime/policy generation.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §13 Runtime qualification; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: recovery integration: change startup-only policy, attempt stale-generation execution and recreate worker; assert pending status before matching qualified report and activation only afterward.

text: Live-refreshable policy controls must use their actual activation semantics and expose control coverage and last verification without unsupported immediate-active claims.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §13 Independent authority and Runtime qualification; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Scope and priorities / Should”
verify: integration + review: exercise a supported live update and delayed/failed activation; inspect effective enforcement generation, administrator coverage/verification and user limitation output.

text: Sensitive privileged execution must require current grants and short leases so controller disconnection prevents continuation after lease expiry.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §13 Limits; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: security + recovery: disconnect controller with worker active, advance/measure a declared clock and observe no privileged continuation after qualified expiry; initial maximum lease is 30 seconds as a pilot test parameter, with process/external outcome reported separately.

text: Authorization-service failure must fail closed for affected reads/actions and privileged continuation.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §28 Dependency failure; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: security integration: make authority unavailable before dispatch and during continuation; inspect no unauthorized reads/effects and explicit blocked/wait state; successful recovery revalidates current authority.

text: Required audit/evidence unavailability must block affected sensitive dispatch, and telemetry gaps must remain visibly stale or alerted.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§22,28 Dependency failure; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration: interrupt required evidence/audit route and heartbeat/telemetry independently; assert affected sensitive effects do not dispatch and missing observations are not represented as success/zero usage.

text: An unreachable runtime must have authority revoked and be reported unknown/quarantined rather than confirmed stopped.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§12 runtime states,22,28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: recovery integration: lose heartbeat/transport during an owned operation; inspect lease revocation, unknown effect/termination state and no replacement write until reconciliation.

text: Runtime recovery must revalidate current identity/membership, policy, approval expiry and remaining budget before authorized continuation.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8 Interruption,12 runtime states,28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: recovery + security integration: recreate with each authority condition revoked/stale and assert denial, then permit a valid current case; restored snapshots cannot resurrect authority.

text: A replacement/restarted worker must use a new fencing generation that rejects old-worker writes and publication.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8,26,28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: concurrency + recovery integration: retain an old independent worker across replacement and race old/new writes; observe zero accepted stale-generation effects.

text: Unknown in-flight effects must be reconciled by original operation identity before new writes; expiry, lease release, lost acknowledgements or restart must not authorize blind replay.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8 Effect protocol,28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: recovery integration: crash after actual owned-target write and before acknowledgement, recreate, query/reconcile original receipt and assert one effect; unresolved outcomes remain waiting/unknown.

text: Opened actions must record exact target, operation identity, complete arguments/digest, artifact preconditions, actor/policy, required approval, budget reservation and execution lease before dispatch.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8 Effect protocol,10 Tools,14 Approval
verify: integration + security: inspect durable pre-dispatch bindings; change target/digest/precondition/policy or send partial streamed arguments and verify no dispatch; allowed complete operation settles from execution-path receipt.

text: An exact-action approval must remain bound to tenant, Space, actor, task, target/action, normalized argument/artifact digest, policy revision, expiry and applicable value limits.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §14 Approval contract; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security integration using existing authority: valid synthetic gate allows exact operation; independently altered/expired bindings deny with no effects. This does not qualify real human judgment or SSO.

text: Remote access must not expose public SSH/RDP/VNC by default; supported relays and file/preview/desktop paths must be authenticated, short-lived and scoped.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §12 Deployment profiles
verify: security + deployment review after approval: inspect actual listening interfaces/rules and attempt unauthenticated/expired/wrong-scope access; verify supported relay succeeds only within grant and lifetime.

text: Sensitive runtime controls and qualification evidence must apply to the exact tested deployment, with no software-only claim of Sentry/hardware assurance.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§12–13,32; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Problem and outcome”, §“Explicit non-scope”
verify: review + deployment security: compare published support/control matrix with actual topology/image and evidence; reject unsupported claim or missing mandatory control; hardware claims require separate actual integration evidence.

text: High-severity authorization, isolation, stale-approval or duplicate-effect defects must block the affected release profile.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§2 Release discipline,29–30; docs/planning/roadmap.md:40
verify: review + security: verify qualification/reporting cannot mark an affected profile supported with an unresolved release-blocking finding, regardless of positive task or latency results.

text: The finite required release suite must observe zero forbidden effects, cross-Space disclosures, unauthorized dispatches, duplicate effects and stale-generation writes.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§29,31; docs/planning/roadmap.md:28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: security + concurrency + recovery: independently inspect owned destination counters, files, dispatch/receipt records and disclosure canaries throughout required cases; retain finite sample limits and every failure.

text: Actual Ask and Plan requests must leave target servers and repositories unchanged.
source: docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv:24; docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§5 Intent controls,31 UX-03; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: e2e + security: send real local requests, including forged/escalating writes on every exposed path, and compare target files/repository digests plus owned target-service mutation counters; repeat equivalent requests on approved remote environment for external qualification.

text: New conversations must start in Ask and must not silently exceed their recorded intent ceiling.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §5 Intent controls; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration: create a conversation without intent, issue action-like text and inspect Ask ceiling/no target effects; accepting an explicit Act transition is a separate positive case.

text: Ordinary Ask must use an authorized service worker with no Space filesystem or unrestricted shell and must not provision or wake a Space VM.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§3 Switching,7 Three execution classes; docs/planning/roadmap.md:36; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: integration + security: execute successful, denied and failing ordinary Ask requests; inspect provision/wake/mount/dispatch counters and service process access. Actual qualified service-worker isolation/no-VM inventory requires approved environment.

text: Plan must save a versioned plan through the artifact service while retaining its prohibition on target mutation.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §5 Intent controls; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: integration: submit Plan, reopen versioned artifact through owning service and inspect distinct artifact write alongside zero target-service/file/repository effects.

text: Routine transcript, audit and explicit memory-control persistence must remain distinct from forbidden Ask/Plan target mutation.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §5 Intent controls; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration: actual Ask/Plan persistence succeeds under its existing grants while target-write attempts remain denied; inspect respective service records and target state.

text: Live read-only computer inspection must be explicitly declared and satisfy required capability, access, resource and startup-consent checks.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§3 Switching,5 Intent controls,7; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration + security: undeclared/missing-consent inspection cannot mount/start/access computer; supported declared read-only case succeeds without write authority and exposes computer transition.

text: Act execution must follow explicit user selection or accepted task preflight and remain within its recorded TaskEnvelope.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§5 Intent controls,10 Task envelope; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: e2e + security: actual bounded Act operation modifies one authorized fixture after admission; unaccepted preflight, scope expansion and outside-envelope operations produce zero effects.

text: The task envelope must bind requirement revision, allowed effects, exact targets, source audience, model/runtime policy, cost ceilings, continuation and verification obligations.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§10 Task envelope,26 admission; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: integration + review: inspect persisted envelope and preflight; altered/stale target, requirements or policy cannot expand effects, and routine covered operations do not require redundant approval.

text: Changing tool or model/quality choice must not raise the task intent ceiling or bypass an exact-action gate.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§1 Product invariants,9 Understandable model,10,14; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: security integration: switch model profile and tool route during Ask/Plan or bounded Act; assert unchanged intent/effect limits and no gated effect without current exact approval.

text: The preflight must disclose intended result, sources, Space/audience, required computer, model policy, payer/cost limits and later approval needs, labeling unknown costs/support.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §5 Intent controls; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration + review: inspect actual admission/preflight responses for service and computer work, denied support and unknown cost; compare disclosed values to authoritative envelope and allocation.

text: A task requesting a conflicting file, package-install, browser-profile or desktop resource must queue with its current owner and conflict reason.
source: docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv:28; docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§12 Computer startup,31 UX-07; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: concurrency integration: independent processes simultaneously contend for each supported resource class; inspect waiting task/owner/resource/reason and actual effects to prove no overlapping conflicting writes.

text: Strict single-computer contention must not silently allocate additional VMs/workers.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§4 Membership,12 contention,26 profile; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: concurrency + e2e: record every allocator call and inventory before/during contention and duplicate admission; local fixture allocation count remains one and approved provider inventory must independently prove actual one-VM behavior.

text: Tenant, Space, Task and resource bindings must remain immutable through admission, queueing, execution and recovery, independent of current tab/Space selection.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§3 Switching and identity,26; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Scope and priorities / Should”
verify: security + concurrency integration: queue in Space A, switch to B and recreate services; observe original A target or explicit conflict, no remount/credential crossover and no wrong-Space release/write.

text: Only demonstrably disjoint work whose resource separation can be enforced may execute concurrently with leased mutable work.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§10 Tools,12 contention,21 Mutation barrier; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: concurrency integration: disjoint allowed operations make progress, overlapping operations queue, and an unenforceable-disjointness case pauses/serializes rather than racing.

text: When strong per-task isolation is absent, serialization may admit only workloads safe under the common Space trust boundary; locks/worktrees must not qualify hostile or differently privileged code.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§4 Membership,12 contention; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“Scope and priorities / Must”, §“Explicit non-scope”
verify: security + review: same-trust serialized workload succeeds; hostile/differently privileged request is refused without an explicitly permitted isolated backend; inspect matrix never calls serialization isolation.

text: Each supported run on the shared VM must receive its own process identity, scratch directory, dependency context and resource lease to the extent actually supported by the backend.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §12 Computer startup and contention
verify: integration + security on qualified backend: inspect independent running processes, scratch/dependency bindings and leases; test unauthorized cross-run access as required by advertised isolation; unsupported fields cannot be advertised as enforced.

text: Canonical file promotion must use controlled commits with version preconditions instead of unconstrained conflicting writes.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§10 Tools,12 contention,15 Draft/canonical; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: concurrency integration: two processes start from the same base; one authorized promotion succeeds and stale/conflicting promotion queues/conflicts without silent overwrite; inspect canonical bytes/version.

text: Cancelling a queued request must prevent its later acquisition/execution while allowing subsequent eligible queued work to progress.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8 cancellation,12 contention; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: concurrency + recovery integration: cancel a real waiting task then release owner/recreate queue service; cancelled task never mutates or receives a live lease, next valid waiter can progress.

text: Owner failure or lease expiry must preserve resource ownership and fencing until safe transfer; timeout alone must not imply old process termination.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8,12,21,28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”, §“Open questions and risks”
verify: concurrency + recovery: crash/disconnect owner, expire lease, retain stale process and race replacement; observe no overlapping conflicting effects and no transfer based only on unconfirmed termination.

text: Lease/queue service recreation must preserve queued work, current ownership and fencing rather than granting duplicate owners or allocations.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§8,12,28; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: recovery integration across independent processes: recreate service during owned and queued phases, inspect durable state, then safely resume once; stale owner and duplicate acquisition cannot write.

text: Shared VM compute cost must be counted once to its owning Space; task views must use an explicit allocation method or show unallocated shared cost.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §11 Make cost ownership visible; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: integration + accounting: concurrent tasks and waiting tasks share one measured fixture interval; inspect totals and task allocation so full machine charge is never multiplied. Actual deployed duration/provider charges require approved observation.

text: Waiting, task Stop or conversation archive must not imply an already-running/reserved VM or retained storage is free; compute, storage, estimates and settled costs must be distinct.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§11 cost ownership,12 deployment; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”, §“Scope and priorities / Should”
verify: integration: exercise wait/Stop/archive with running fixture resource and retained storage, inspect continuing charge categories and uncertainty; compare deployed inventory/usage with actual costs only after approval.

text: Computer provisioning/wake must occur only after admission of a task requiring computer capabilities.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §12 Computer startup; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: integration: before admission and for ordinary service work allocation count stays zero; authorized computer task causes one visible preparing/validating transition and bounded allocation.

text: Suspension must require no active driver or noncheckpointable workload, an explicit saved-state policy and settled resource leases.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §12 Computer startup and contention
verify: integration + recovery: attempt suspend with each unsafe prerequisite then a safe owned case; inspect denied/queued unsafe suspension and preserved committed state with leases settled in successful case.

text: If desktop/browser input is opened, each session must have at most one active input driver with independently granted viewers.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Single-driver ownership; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: concurrency + security: race two driver requests and viewers, verify one current driver, allowed view-only observation and zero input under view-only grant; old driver generation is rejected.

text: Human takeover must block every conflicting GUI/shell/SDK/API/browser/filesystem mutation path, invalidate queued input and disclose in-flight effects before granting human control.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Single-driver and Mutation barrier; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: concurrency + security e2e if opened: run actual conflicting mutations through every path during takeover, observe barrier/effects and new human fencing generation; disjoint read-only work continues only where enforceable.

text: Human disconnection/driver expiry must leave mutable work paused; agent resume must be explicit and require fresh observation, base-version reconciliation and current permission.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Mutation barrier; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: recovery e2e if input opened: disconnect, expire lease, edit fixture as human, reconnect/restart and attempt stale input; no automatic resume/replay, explicit valid return reobserves/reconciles before effects.

text: Queued GUI actions must bind a current observation and lease, expire rather than replay after reconnect, and reobserve after relevant focus/geometry/state changes.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Controlled operation and Streaming; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security + recovery e2e if GUI opened: change focus/frame/geometry, expire/reconnect and send queued action; verify zero stale/wrong-target effects and successful freshly authorized postcondition-checked action.

text: Any supported sensitive authentication session must prevent other agent-controlled processes from reading its profile, cookies, clipboard or input channels.
source: docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv:31; docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§21 Authentication isolation,31 UX-10; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: security e2e on supported actual browser/OS boundary: independent adversarial agent processes attempt profile/cookie/clipboard/input access during synthetic login; inspect canary disclosure and unauthorized input counts. A profile-name/directory test cannot qualify isolation.

text: Unsupported sensitive-session isolation must block the flow before authentication or credential exposure and explain a permitted private/supported alternative.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§21 Authentication isolation,31 UX-10; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”, §“Scope and priorities / Must”
verify: security integration: request sensitive login on absent/unqualified/lost isolation; assert zero browser-login start, credential handoff or agent input/capture and inspect safe alternative. Explicitly qualify refusal only.

text: Required sensitive-session isolation and separate grants must be verified before authentication begins.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §§13,21 Authentication isolation; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: security integration: spoof a named profile, expired qualification or stale grant; independent actual access probes fail readiness and login remains blocked; approved supported boundary allows synthetic user-only login.

text: Agent capture and input must be suspended throughout user-only authentication.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Sensitive sessions; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”
verify: security e2e if supported: inject synthetic login canaries and simultaneous capture/input requests; verify no capture bytes or agent input during user-only phase and explicit allowed transitions afterward.

text: User-only authentication suspension must also prevent sensitive capture in recordings and telemetry.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Sensitive sessions; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Goals and measurable success”
verify: security e2e: exercise actual configured recording/log/telemetry paths during synthetic authentication; independently inspect outputs for zero credential/input canary disclosure and denied capture; inspect configuration cannot reopen capture.

text: Personal authenticated browser data must not be imported into a group desktop by default.
source: docs/Agent_Fabric_Master_Product_and_Technical_Specification_v1.1.md §21 Sensitive sessions; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f06-runtime/product-brief.md §“User journeys”, §“Constraints and qualification evidence”
